title: CNF for Machine Transitions
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, and let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$. The transition CNF is the concatenation, over all codec gate indices, of the CNFs associated with the corresponding gates.
